name: Kamishiro Yuka
source:
Self-acclaimed personal guard of Louis. She acts defensively to everyone she meets and finds it difficult to accept friendship. 

She is a heavy otaku and often blurs the line between fiction and reality. Transposing her (eluded) BL to real life scenarios. She values Amamoto Louis very highly and goes as far as wanting to possess her sexually as well. 

Secret identity of that cat thing.
